title: Major Architecture, UI & Performance Update
label: Internal Alpha
summary: VISAR Edge transitions from a feature-based assistant to a layered cognitive system. This update lays the foundation for Memory, Web autonomy, and safe system control, with major gains in intent accuracy, UI polish, and performance efficiency.

sections.title: Added & New Features
items: Introduced the Intent Router with a 4-layered architecture: Deterministic rules, Context checks, Confidence gating, and LLM-assisted fallback.
Added 3 new executable 'Hands' (actuators): MEMORY (store/recall), WEB_OPEN, and SYSTEM_CLOSE.
Deployed a Hardware_Manager to dynamically adjust performance behavior based on available RAM and CPU core counts.
Integrated advanced profiling and diagnostics tools: thread_monitor, yappi_monitor, and profiler_monitor, alongside a user-configurable FPS Monitor.
Implemented a full sci-fi overhaul for the Settings Tab, featuring glowing textboxes, sliders, toggles, an API key selector, and an environment variable editor.
Added drop shadows to glowing UI boxes for better depth perception and updated button designs for VISAR Chat Core and Live Users.
Finalized a gradient-based background with controlled transparency (alpha ~240-230) and a gradient fallback when wallpapers are disabled.

sections.title: Improvements & System Redux
items: Replaced the legacy pygame voice speaker with an MPV-based voice engine to support streaming TTS audio and improve interruption handling.
Optimized the center panel animation lifecycle, dynamically starting and stopping timers based on UI visibility to prevent unnecessary CPU usage.
Implemented QPixmap caching for wallpapers to drastically reduce UI redraw overhead.
Improved the reliability of subprocess launching and app resolution within sys_core for OS-level commands (Chrome, Calculator, Notepad).

sections.title: Fixes & Security
items: Fixed all known intent misclassification bugs, significantly reducing false positives where casual phrases triggered system actions.
Resolved bugs where animation timers continued running while UI layers were hidden off-screen.
Patched multiple offline-handling issues in firebase_config.py to improve backend robustness when network connectivity drops.

sections.title: Removed & Deprecated
items: Removed the pygame voice engine dependency in favor of the new MPV-based streaming architecture.

notes: Version 1.1.2.0 establishes a robust foundation for advanced cognitive processing. The introduction of the 4-layer Intent Router guarantees high-accuracy command execution, while the new Hardware Manager and animation optimizations ensure the system scales elegantly across diverse hardware environments.
